strategies.name: Fused block-wise reduce-scatter then all-gather

Doubles collective count to 16 dispatches but reduces per-dispatch payload by ~8x for reduce-scatter phase, trading off bandwidth for latency. Enables per-block parallelism across ranks within each iteration.

strategies.name: Pipelined overlapped computation-communication
strategies.desc: Issue next all-reduce asynchronously while computing scaling factors from previous result, overlapping communication with local negative-ReLU and scaling operations. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but hides computation latency behind network transfers. Requires careful buffer management to avoid race conditions between dependent iterations.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level aggregation
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node all-reduce (smaller world size) followed by inter-node all-reduce for each of the 8 iterations. Total 16 dispatches but leverages faster intra-node fabric (NVLink/ICI) for bulk of traffic. Represents hierarchical topology-aware optimization trading dispatch count for per-dispatch efficiency.

strategies.name: Vectorized batch all-reduce with metadata
strategies.desc:
Pack scaling factors as metadata alongside data tensor, performing single all-reduce per iteration that simultaneously aggregates both data and the 8 scalar factors. Reduces to 8 dispatches with slightly larger payload (3072 + 8 elements). Amortizes collective overhead by fusing data and control-plane information, trading payload size for simplified synchronization.
